init.name: db_checklist_create
init.run: docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE checklist;'

init.name: db_blocker_create
init.run: docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE blocker;'

init.name: db_checklist_schema
init.run: docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -d checklist < examples/checklist/checklist/schema/checklist.postgres.sql

init.name: db_blocker_schema
init.run: docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -d blocker < examples/checklist/blocker/schema/blocker.postgres.sql
